negative_evidence.F124C: Independent TRAIN-only node-slot learner scored 0/48 paired in each lane; fixed-depth dependent classification and latent-slot collapse observed. This is advisory not source code reuse.
negative_evidence.interpretation: Preserve both negatives and frozen threshold; 62/64 fixed control makes +0.05 impossible at exact 64/64 symbolic ceiling, thus require prospective headroom eligibility on a new source family.

mechanism.name: Public-token-keyed path-preserving sum-product composition
mechanism.novelty: Unlike hard-K2 pruning or two learned node slots, preserve distinct (public node, raw incoming dst token) hypotheses, merging ONLY byte-identical public keys by addition of learned mass and gradient. No global candidate truncation.
mechanism.raw_attention_features: Bias + sixteen raw signed bitwise interactions + public hop fraction; final two parameters learn gain and cutoff. Never pass engineered exact-equality flag or symbolic answer to learner.

optimizer.initialization: fixed precommitted vector with 20 bounded values

mechanism.overflow: Fail and score as failure, not case exclusion or hidden larger beam

source.paired_marginals: Matched positive/negative preserve whole public topology, edge-role counts, source/destination raw-token multisets, query and distractor counts; raw-source swap creates valid=1 versus valid=0 exact symbolic routes.
source.source_vector_provenance: Existing independently authenticated F118/F120 model-free source, source SHA and candidate SHA pinned before training; never sample candidate source based on CONFIRM.
source.unqualified_generation: Quarantine ambiguous labels, overflow or infeasible source-family examples before learning, with full rejected-case counts; never silently select only successes.

controls.CTRL_F123_DENSE_B: Frozen exact F123 dense B, retrained same fixed schedule only on new F125R TRAIN.
controls.CTRL_F124R_SPARSE2: Frozen exact F124R K2, retrained only on F125R TRAIN.
controls.CTRL_F122_NO_ROUTING: Frozen local learned matcher, public canonical route selection, no oracle.
controls.CTRL_FIXED_SOFT_PATH: Preexisting fixed 12-of-16 bit approximate public path.
controls.CTRL_QUERY_ONLY: 20 learned public-query features, TRAIN-only fixed optimizer.
controls.CTRL_EXACT_SYMBOLIC_CEILING: Exact raw-token symbolic public path verifier, distinct information-matched ceiling, not an eligible comparison.
controls.CTRL_DISABLE_KEY_MERGE: Precommitted ablation retaining all unmerged states within same capacity, diagnostic only.

headroom_eligibility.rule: If prospective F125-R TRAIN fixed control is within 0.08 of exact symbolic ceiling, mark UNINFORMATIVE_HEADROOM. Do not reseed, alter cases, change threshold or consume CONFIRM.

resource.primary: Comparable operation-count bookkeeping across models counting scans, adjacency indexing, token hashing bytes, sorting, merges, state allocation, bit interactions, multiply-adds, gradient propagation and retained-state storage.
resource.runtime_secondary: Report separately pinned runtime on same platform; mixed primitive event proxy is not equivalent to true compute-cost parity.

evaluation.holdout: Confirmation may be used once only after independent prospective authority, immutable exact source and full regression, never for tuning or training.
evaluation.failure_policy: Negative/overbudget/uninformative outcomes remain evidence. Never relabel engineering passing as scientific acceptance.

current_gate: Freeze F125-R source and evaluate tamper/source schema only on Ubuntu and Windows. No learner code, TRAIN or CONFIRM graph generation, new scheduling or SCIENTIFIC first-use.
